Name: Deluxe Journal - Starblue Valley Recolor
Author: xxHowdyxx
Description:
[b][i][size=3]Installation:[/size]
[/i][/b]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi
[/url]2. Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436http://]Deluxe Journal[/url] and locate the assets folder; ui.png and building-icons.png should be visible
3. Create a copy of these png files (in case you want to revert the changes)
4. [u]﻿Replace[/u] the original UI files with the downloaded, modified ones
- You should get a pop-up asking you to replace the files. If this does [i]not[/i] occur, make sure you are moving it to the [u]assets[/u] folder and you have found the aforementioned image files
5. Launch with SMAPI and enjoy a more cohesive journal experience :)

[b]
[/b][i][b][size=3]Side Notes:[/size][/b]
[/i]I am [i]not[/i] a computer genius; I didn't know how even to do a recolor before I took this on. If you find any issues or have any ideas for improvement, please let me know, and I will do my best to fix/incorporate them. I want to give a big shoutout to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strangelyliteral?gameId=1303]strangelyliteral[/url] and [url=http://https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CherrySymphony?gameId=1303]CherrySymphony[/url] for pioneering and continuing the Starblue Valley mod series, respectively. These were the only recolor mods I have ever downloaded, and I love them to bits. Secondly, [url=http://https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MolsonCAD?gameId=1303]MolsonCAD[/url] did the brunt of the work for this. I did not design any material in this file; I simply colored over it.

Considering this is just a UI replacement, I assume this recolor will work in other versions of Stardew Valley as long as SMAPI and Deluxe Journal remain compatible. Please don't quote me on this, though; again, I am [i]not[/i] a computer genius.
